notes: Lindner does not publish a full-time MBA class profile with test scores, work experience or demographics on any official page found (program page, MBA admissions page, Lindner by the Numbers). The out-of-state surcharge figure is on https://www.uc.edu/about/bursar/tuition-fees/prior-year-fees/2023-2024-fees11/2025-26-Out-of-State-Surcharge.html. The 96,846 salary on the program page is an average, not a median, and undated; the career outcomes page median is used instead. Existing women_pct and class_size values from US News should be dropped or kept per house rules; official class size 36 (Class of 2026) replaces the US News enrollment figure.
